files.summary: Testing and performance spec (owner R5, reviewer R1; TST-01..TST-24). Covers: how test levels map to spec section 15.3, with a Mermaid CI flow; six Vitest projects (unit, browser on channel chrome with a persistent context, integration against the Compose Postgres with per-file template databases, bench, ai-eval, tools) plus a config snippet; the Playwright projects e2e/a11y/perf/bringup; test naming and requirement traceability (strict mode, per-command SYS-02 check); coverage include globs, thresholds, ratchet and file-count check; fault injection on client (abort at the N-th onsuccess, synchronous EIO, FaultyBlobStore) and server (GUC-gated trigger that raises P0001, pg_sleep delay), all behind a root-only audited harness when FAULT_INJECTION=1 and never on production; oracle probes and a fault matrix; property tests with fast-check (seed 42, 100/1,000/10,000 runs); e2e list E1-E25, including the offline gate by stopping the server and launchPersistentContext; a11y with axe; AI eval, RAG-leak, litmus and drift checks in CI; the precise frame metric (PipelineReporter, V = median BeginFrame, D_i = (1 + dropped)·V, nearest-rank p95 <= 16.7 ms, VRR invalidation, zero LoAF > 50 ms from our origin); the lab runner's setup and security (runner group restricted to perf-lab.yml on main, no secrets) and the calibration rate; a PERFORMANCE BUDGETS table with every numeric target from the spec, internal budgets and CI budgets; the budgets.json TypeScript schema, a JSON example and check-budgets exit codes; flakiness quarantine rules; test definition of done; Demo Day rehearsal scripts per section 17.1 (W15/W16/W17 x2/T-1, preflight T-7/T-1/T-1h, 0:00-0:30 scripts with failure drills). Pilot numbers are labelled 'pilot figure — re-measure on the lab machine'.

Deployment and CI spec (owner R5, reviewer R2; OPS-01..OPS-22). Covers: compose.yaml with web (Caddy), app (Node 24 + Fastify) and db (PostgreSQL 18.6 + pgvector), each with named volumes, healthchecks, internal backplane and edge networks and a loopback-only port 127.0.0.1:4717, with no credentials anywhere. The db entrypoint generates the owner and app passwords at first start into 0440 secret files, and the app runs dbmate as owner through an env prefix, never argv. Also covers compose.prod.yaml (image digests from .env.images, FAULT_INJECTION 0, secret files, 80/443/443udp override), plus the override, test and staging files. The Caddyfile has isolation headers (COOP/COEP require-corp/CORP), a CSP import generated by security at build time, an HSTS prod-only glob import, lb_try_duration 15s / lb_try_interval 250ms, stream_close_delay 5m on /ws, and immutable vs no-cache routes with versioned /models and /ort paths. Other sections: Dockerfile targets deps/build/web/app/db; GHCR multi-arch images pinned by digest, never overwritten, with provenance/SBOM and imagetools mirrors; README 3-command bring-up with a CI bringup job that fails over 240 s with Docker Hub blocked and no login; workflows ci/main/nightly/perf-lab/docs/release (11-step release including a tag == package.json check, perf evidence, live ai-eval, traceability gate and approval-gated deploy); ruleset and CODEOWNERS; the GitHub secrets table and leak runbook; release tagging; deploy.sh (flock, images.lock, pre-deploy backup, a single up -d --wait --wait-timeout 240, smoke, auto-rollback) and manual rollback; OFF-05 demo deploys (hash-only patch approval); VPS cloud-init, sysctls and Hetzner firewall; provider fallback Hetzner CX33 -> OVH VPS-2; backups with pg_dump -Fc + rclone copy to R2 (7 daily + 4 weekly), a restore runbook and a drill schedule; UptimeRobot on /readyz plus a 6-hourly deep smoke; cost table and caps; the deploy state machine and invariants D-1..D-8.

Stack decisions spec, the STACK_DECISION.md draft in the section 14.1 format (editor R5, each record has a named owner; DEC-01..DEC-10). Covers: the process Mermaid; a pre-registration procedure (a prereg/<Dn> PR with anchored scales merged before any evidence, checked by git timestamp); evidence rules (pilot figures labelled, each paired with the spike that replaces it); freeze rules. Records D1 UI (Solid provisional; React fallback via the S1b kata; styling; terminal renderer with 3 or more candidates; editor), D2a kernel language, D2b placement/IPC, D3 backend, D4 transport, D5 DB (with examiner corrections applied), D6 query layer/migrations (with a migration-runner screening table), D7 client storage/offline shell (with service-worker and offline-verifier sub-matrices), D8 vector store (marked fragile, with 3 spec reasons), D9 embedding, D10 LLM (selection rule quoted verbatim, bake-off candidates), D11 predictor, D12 deployment/object storage/reverse proxy/observability, D13 auth/security, and D14 test toolchain plus a repo tooling table. Each record has context with ranked constraints, 3 or more options including the expected loser, criteria and weights with the requirement that the team re-commit its own weights in a PR before re-measuring, a score table from the research, evidence, the decision and its consequences, risks and mitigations, and a reversal trigger. Also: the frozen stack table; reversal candidates; a trigger monitoring table tied to budget IDs; the full text of C1-C18 mapped to records; a record template; the PreRegistration TS interface; a sensitivity-analysis template with a rank-reversal-distance worked example; the evidence layout; and the ADR template with an instructor-approval field. Timing answer for the user: prereg W1 -> stack defence W4 -> gates W7/W11/W14 -> freeze W16 -> final release and v1.0.0 production deploy W17-18.

cross_spec_requests: 00-product/requirements-traceability: register the ID prefixes TST-nn (13-quality), OPS-nn (14-devops) and DEC-nn (15-decisions). Also register the Vitest/Playwright project names (unit, browser, integration, bench, ai-eval, tools; e2e, a11y, perf, bringup) so traceability --strict and --gate recognise them.

05-wm/window-manager: replace the local frame-metric wording with a pointer to 13-quality §3.11.3 (PipelineReporter, V = median BeginFrame interval, D_i = (1 + dropped)·V, nearest-rank p95 <= 16.7 ms, VRR invalidation, zero LoAF > 50 ms with same-origin sourceURL).
03-kernel/processes: expose the run-token bound as a pure function in bound.ts (clamp(hwc-2-(embedActive?ortThreads:0),1,6)) so property tests and PROC-04.starvation budget params can import it.

04-vfs and 09-database: confirm the fault-injection 'node op' = one inode-row write, name the oracle probe queries listed in 13 §3.6, and confirm the plotinium_fault_tick trigger raising P0001 on the N-th row behind a GUC set only by the root-only audited harness.

06-sync/offline-and-sync: confirm the offline-indicator budgets (OFF-04 <= 1 s on socket close, <= 26 s on silent drop), the lease TTL 30 s / 15 s demo override via LEASE_TTL_MS, and heartbeat at TTL/3 as used in e2e E2 and deploy gap targets.

11-server/backend-api: (a) the app entrypoint reads OWNER_DATABASE_URL/OWNER_PASSWORD_FILE only for dbmate and seed and unsets them before exec main.js; (b) relax SRV-17 rollback wording to permit expand-only migrations to remain after an image rollback; (c) add a free-disk check to /api/readyz; (d) expose a faultInjection flag in HealthReport, which must be false when PLOTINIUM_ENV=production.

09-database: rename env vars to the backend-api names (DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE, OWNER_*), adopt the generated-at-first-start password files under /run/plotinium (0440, uid 999:gid 1000), and mark every migration expand-only or contract so deploy.sh can refuse a contract migration without a two-release gap.

12-security/security-model: confirm HSTS is production-only via the prod.d glob import, that csp.caddy is generated at build time with inline-script hashes, the exact Permissions-Policy string, the DB-password generation flow in 14 §3.3, and the lab-runner trust model (runner group restricted to perf-lab.yml@refs/heads/main, schedule/workflow_dispatch only, no secrets).
10-ai/ai-safety: add the AGT-09 local-demo option (LLM_UPSTREAM_URL + LLM_UPSTREAM_TOKEN_FILE per backend §3.13.8, or CI evidence) and publish the bake-off results table that D10 references.
10-ai/rag: serve models and ORT under versioned paths /models/<lock-id>/ and /ort/<ort-version>/ (immutable caching) and maintain models.lock consumed by the release workflow.
02-boot: confirm a single inline boot script (hashed into CSP) and no modulepreload polyfill, so the CSP hash list and BOOT-10.boot-js budget stay stable.
01-architecture identity/version: add the 'verify' CI job (tag == package.json version == build identity) and serve version.json with Cache-Control no-cache.

16-delivery/implementation-plan (planned path): schedule prereg PRs W1, the stack defence W4, gates W7/W11/W14, restore drills, Demo Day rehearsals W15/W16/W17x2/T-1, the freeze W16, and the v1.0.0 production deploy W17-18.
03-kernel/syscall-abi: decide whether ENOMEM is a registered errno. 13 §6 maps memory-budget failures to it only provisionally.
01-architecture: link the reversal-candidate list in 15 §3.21 from the architecture risks section.
README (specs index): confirm the owner assignments used in the headers (13/14 R5, 15 R5 editor with the per-record owners).
open_questions: Will the instructor accept the PipelineReporter-based frame metric (13 §3.11.3) as the definition of the spec's frame-time target, and how should runs on displays below 59.88 Hz be treated?
Is a lab-spec machine available for the self-hosted perf runner, or must we use a lab-matched machine with the calibration rate max(1, t_lab/t_runner)?

Demo Day: which instance is demoed (production VPS or a local stack)? Are live AI prompts allowed against production? Is the LLM upstream token route for AGT-09 approved? Is a hash-only patch deploy acceptable during the demo window (OFF-05)?
Can Vitest browser-mode coverage be merged with the unit coverage for the thresholds, or must browser-only files be exempted?
May the repository be public (needed for free Actions minutes and public GHCR packages)?
Who owns the domain, the Hetzner/OVH, Cloudflare R2 and UptimeRobot accounts, and who funds the VPS and domain costs (cost table in 14 §3.16)?
What are the lab network bandwidth and RTT, and the examiner machine spec, for the 240 s bring-up and the offline tests?
Is the staging RAM on the same VPS enough, or is a second instance needed?
Will the instructor accept temperature-0 rulings for the AI eval pass criteria, given provider nondeterminism?
Is Node 26 LTS allowed if it ships before the freeze, and is a fallback pre-approved for each frozen choice (for example React for D1, OVH for D12)?
Is FsBlobStore on a Docker volume acceptable as 'object storage' under the spec, or is an S3-compatible store required?
Which languages are in the hidden RAG evaluation set?
D1 terminal renderer: does the team have enough Rust fluency to pilot a WASM candidate, or which third candidate should replace it?
Should ENOMEM be added to the syscall errno registry?
